title: fix(git): keep leading dashes in git grep search patterns
body:
Code search without the code indexer stripped leading `-` from the keywords before passing them to git grep, so searching `--verbose` also matched `verbose`, and `->` searched for `>`. The stripping kept user input from being read as an option; attaching the pattern to `-e` as one argument (`-e--verbose`) does that too while keeping the pattern intact.

Found while working on https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/39403, whose match positions currently mirror this stripping.

AI usage disclosure: Yes, I used AI to write code, review changes and verify the factuality of the overview I provided. I take full responsibility for the code in this PR.
